summary: The audit checks 45 units of graduate coursework and research, every course letter graded with a B or better: the seven required courses, two electives' worth of full-value courses and minicourses, MCP 299 rotations, and molecular biology (BIO 83, whose units do not count toward the 45, or competency from earlier study). Checked by hand: 6 units of advanced courses the Director of Graduate Studies approves, the written qualifying exam and the 3.0 GPA. Outside credit is not accepted.

program.why: Grading: "Courses taken to meet program requirements must be taken for a letter grade and students must earn a minimum grade of at least a 'B' in every individual course."

totals.label: BIO 83 does not count toward the 45 units
totals.why: "If not met, then the Stanford undergrad course BIO 83 can be taken to meet the requirement, but the units will not be applied toward the 45-unit minimum"

OQIGzxYu.why: "Students should have basic competency in molecular biology. This requirement can be met based on undergrad curriculum/research. If not met, then the Stanford undergrad course BIO 83 can be taken to meet the requirement, but the units will not be applied toward the 45-unit minimum for the MS."

children.name: Competency from undergraduate curriculum or research

MNM4fXfv.why: "Advanced graduate courses or minicourses for a minimum of 6 units total. These courses do not need to be MCP courses but must be in a relevant scientific topic and approved by the Director of Graduate Studies."

yl1slGuD.why: "Students earning the M.S. degree instead of the PhD are required to complete the written section of the Qualifying Exam."
